supported.note: Repository-owned iOS playable video: kind video with video { src, poster?, width?, height? }. Local MP4/WebM assets autoplay muted inline with conversation Play, pause and seek with its clock, and reset on Replay. No browser media controls, time labels, or extra text footer. No video-control event is required.

Repository-owned iOS poll, not an upstream registry component. kind "poll" with question, options, optional selectionMode single|multiple (multiple when omitted), optional voters with local avatars, and votes. Event poll-vote { messageId, participantId, optionId, voted } plays the recorded option transition from that event's time. poll-option and overlay poll-details remain. No creation sheet, counts, percentages, or multi-voter layout is claimed from the recording.

iOS only. kind "app-card" with appCard { url, live: true, app: "checkout", height? } embeds one live Photon checkout in the thread from an origin listed in VITE_PHOTON_CHECKOUT_ORIGINS; its Apple Pay button opens the recreated full-phone Apple Pay presentation. Repo-owned renderer code, not a pinned component.

catalogueOnly.reason: macOS caller-owned menu. It is not an iOS authoring surface.
macOS caller-owned menu. The iOS plus menu is supported.
macOS details stay on the macOS shell. iOS details and group details are supported.

unsupported.reason: No Photon or mini-app package is installed. The only exception is the live Photon checkout card (kind "app-card", app "checkout", iOS), which the renderer hosts itself.
A FaceTime card shows a visual state. It does not place a call.
Apple Cash and Apple Pay controls do not move money. The checkout card stays a presentation.
